variants.headline: A new government takes shape
variants.body: A new government comprising {members} has been formed. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Formation is the beginning of governing
variants.body: The colony has a new government comprising {members}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: New ministry, practical obligations
variants.body: Government formation has produced an administration comprising {members}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
